b1-25-01.title: Communicative Challenge: A Changing City
b1-25-01.scenario: Károly asks Meg how the city has changed in recent years. You (Meg) say that the city has become much more beautiful and that a lot of change has happened.
b1-25-01.prompt: Tell Károly what has happened to the city.
cues: Say that the city has become more beautiful
Say that a lot has changed
b1-25-01.target: A város az utóbbi években nagyon szépült. Sok változás történt.
b1-25-01.english: The city has become much more beautiful in recent years. A lot of change has happened.
b1-25-01.canDo: I can say that something changes or becomes something, with -vá/-vé and verbs such as szépül.

b1-25-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Learning Step by Step
b1-25-02.scenario: Petra asks Meg how she is learning Hungarian. You (Meg) say that you are not in a hurry and that you learn gradually, step by step.
b1-25-02.prompt: Tell Petra how you are learning Hungarian.
cues: Say that you are not in a hurry
Say how you learn: gradually and step by step
b1-25-02.target: Nem sietek, fokozatosan tanulok magyarul. Lépésről lépésre haladok.
b1-25-02.english: I'm not in a hurry; I learn Hungarian gradually. I make progress step by step.
b1-25-02.canDo: I can say that something happens gradually, with fokozatosan and lépésről lépésre.

b1-25-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Then and Now
b1-25-03.scenario: Károly asks Meg whether many people learn Hungarian. You (Meg) say that in the past few people did, but that today many people do.
b1-25-03.prompt: Tell Károly how the past and the present differ.
cues: Say what the past was like
b1-25-03.target: Míg régen kevés ember tanult magyarul, ma viszont sok ember tanul.
b1-25-03.english: While in the past few people learned Hungarian, today many people do.
b1-25-03.canDo: I can contrast the past with the present with míg régen … ma viszont ….

b1-25-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A New Situation
b1-25-04.scenario: Károly asks Meg how she is coping with the big changes lately. You (Meg) say that you adapted quickly to the new situation and that you reassessed your goals.
b1-25-04.prompt: Tell Károly how you coped with the changes.
cues: Say that you adapted quickly to the new situation
b1-25-04.target: Gyorsan alkalmazkodtam az új helyzethez. Átértékeltem a céljaimat.
b1-25-04.english: I adapted quickly to the new situation. I reassessed my goals.
b1-25-04.canDo: I can say that I adapt to a new situation, with alkalmazkodik and -hoz/-hez.

b1-25-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Internet as a Milestone
b1-25-05.scenario: Petra asks Meg what the spread of the internet meant for people. You (Meg) say that it counted as an important milestone and that it marked a new era.
b1-25-05.prompt: Tell Petra what the spread of the internet meant.
cues: Say that it counted as an important milestone
Say that it marked a new era
b1-25-05.target: Az internet elterjedése fontos mérföldkőnek számított. Korszakváltást jelentett.
b1-25-05.english: The spread of the internet counted as an important milestone. It marked an epochal shift.
b1-25-05.canDo: I can say that something counts as a milestone, with mérföldkőnek számít.

b1-25-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Misi and the Teachers
b1-25-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks Meg what the story about Nyilas Misi is about. You (Meg) say that Misi tells the teachers that he took nothing, and that after the hard days the realisation ripened in him.
b1-25-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra what Misi says and what happens in him.
cues: Say what Misi tells the teachers
Say what ripened in him after the hard days
b1-25-consolidation.target: Misi azt mondja, hogy nem vett el semmit. A nehéz napok után megérett benne a felismerés.
b1-25-consolidation.english: Misi says that he took nothing. After the hard days the realisation ripened in him.
b1-25-consolidation.canDo: I can retell a short story about a pupil who is wrongly accused and grows up, in a few sentences.
